title: The Terminal of the Deep
author: Quentin Halloran
blurb: Mirabel Fairweather, the last human technician on an automated relay station, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
